blockers.detail: interop-tiff may depend only on accord and observe: root Cargo.toml [workspace.metadata.studio.dependencies.hsk-studio-interop-tiff] allowed = [accord, observe]; WORKSPACE_RULES path-deps lists no interop-tiff edge (folio is allowed for package, interop-media, interop-lrcat, press, web, interop-psd, ...). Mapping StudioRasterRecords.channels in interop-tiff needs a new edge interop-tiff -> folio: a lead decision. Item stopped before any code; no Cargo.toml change.
options_for_lead: (a) declare interop-tiff -> folio (folio depends on accord only; develop and harness-core/view/harness already depend on interop-tiff, so no cycle by reading the manifests; edges.py acyclicity check not run here)

(b) keep interop-tiff Folio-free: interop-tiff exposes a neutral extra-plane API (N extra samples with their ExtraSamples values, per-plane samples at 8/16/32) and the record mapping lives in a crate already allowed folio + interop-tiff (harness-core import-tiff path) or interop-psd's raster_proposal (interop-psd allowed: folio, pigment, prism, type; it has no interop-tiff edge either)
blockers.also_needed_either_way: at e3afbb62 interop-tiff decodes at most ONE extra sample on a colour page (scan.rs extra_sample_patch: more than one is refused `extra_samples_unsupported`) and encode.rs writes a single ExtraSamples value through the tiff crate's fixed ColorType (RGBA etc.); a channel record beyond the alpha needs multi-extra-sample decode and encode (a custom sample layout; whether the tiff 0.11.3 encoder takes an arbitrary ColorType is UNVERIFIED). Typed losses TIFF cannot carry: name, display colour, opacity/solidity, kind beyond the ExtraSamples value (0 unspecified / 1 associated / 2 unassociated), visibility, unless written into a private tag or the Photoshop 37724 block (vendor behaviour UNVERIFIED, D5).

exr_finding_item_3.who_reads_or_writes_openexr: No crate reads OpenEXR in product code at e3afbb62. One writer: hsk-studio-composite src/three_d/exr.rs (encode_exr_f32, encode_exr_f32_with_attributes; lane SMB-AE-3D-2/3), used by three_d.rs AuxPlanes::to_exr for the 3D renderer's auxiliary planes (STU-CMP-050). Format written: single-part scanline, uncompressed, every channel 32-bit FLOAT, names 1..31 printable ASCII sorted (no long-name flag), at most 64 channels, extra header attributes of type string only. EXR readers exist only as test helpers (composite tests/three_d_adapter.rs read_exr, tests/support/three_d_scene.rs read_exr_f32).
what_a_channel_record_mapping_needs: an owning crate: composite may depend on folio (WORKSPACE_RULES), but it is the compositor, not an interop crate; interop-raster/interop-tiff have no folio edge; a new interop-exr crate or moving the writer is a lead decision (new crate + DAG entries)
an EXR reader for import / edit-preserve / round-trip (STU-IO-006 row 9 I-EP-X-RT): header parse, chlist, at least NONE compression (ZIP/PIZ/etc. for real files), multi-part, all budgeted (V4-01/02)

a channel naming convention for records (e.g. a layer prefix per record; how Photoshop/Nuke name extra channels is UNVERIFIED, D5) within the 31-byte short-name limit or a long-name flag the writer lacks
depth mapping: record depth 32 -> FLOAT exact, 16 -> HALF or UINT (writer has neither), 8 -> no EXR 8-bit type (transformed, typed loss)
record fields EXR has no slot for (name beyond the channel name, kind, colour, opacity, visibility): string header attributes (writer supports them) or typed losses
tile/sample conversion from the coverage_u8/u16le/f32le tile payloads and the 256 grid (as interop-psd channel_plane does)
